## Problem and resulting behaviour

## Change scope and controlled revisions

Linked issue/change ID; affected source, standards, environments and classification.

## Validation and evidence

Executed commands/results, evidence references and failed/skipped/unrun checks. Distinguish local fixtures from production observations.

## Risk, dependencies and rollback

External inputs, compensating controls, rollback and any exception ID.

## Review and approval

Named reviewer/authority and exact revision reference, or explicitly pending. No self-generated independent assessment. Production execution requires its concrete release record.
